{{Quote|General!|Female Bothan Pop-Dog to Stavin Thaal|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> she was stationed at an underground facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] accessible through a hidden freight lift car inside [[Major Saving's Army Surplus]], a store within [[Kura City]].<ref name="MK" />

When [[Trey Courser]] and [[Drikall Bessarah]], members of the recently reformed Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], arrived at the store, Courser was wearing a [[neoglith masquer]] with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]'s likeness. They were accompanied by a [[Repulsorcart|hover cart]] bearing an unconscious [[Ledina Chott]], a local [[Musician/Legends|musician]] whom they kidnapped. After fooling the [[Unidentified Pop-Dog clerk|clerk]] guarding the entrance and having him escort them to the hidden lift car, Bessarah [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] the clerk with his blaster. Once the lift reached the bottom, the Bothan corporal was standing at the exit. Upon seeing Thaal, she saluted and addressed him as "General." Bessarah immediately shot her with a blaster.<ref name="MK" />
